title: *BEST Rooftop Views of CITY*- 8 min to Broadway
description:
Welcome to Freebird on Fern! Enjoy the best downtown NASHVILLE skyline view!! The rooftop deck and “Million Dollar” view are perfect for your group’s Music City getaway! Professionally designed and decorated for all your photo op/Insta needs!

Most private rooftop in the complex w/ outdoor firepit! End unit that sits on top of the hill.

› 2.6miles to Broadway
› 2miles to Nissan Stadium
› 2.5miles to Germantown
› 5min to Downtown Nashville
› 10min to The Gulch
› 15min to BNA airport

The space
The space
*Million Dollar View* of Downtown Nashville Skyline!

› Fully stocked kitchen with drip coffee maker and Keurig
› Private rooftop balcony with fire pit & outdoor dining
› Safe Neighborhood
› 1,728 sq ft
› Onsite, secured parking/street parking
› Onsite washer and dryer
› Sleeper sofa

LEVEL ONE
Walk in and be greeted by our Nashville map and Freedbird On Fern wall mural. Perfect for a photo op... don't forget to tag us on Insta! @FreebirdOnFern. This level has a private bedroom with King bed, Smart Tv and spacious closet. Access to the garage.

LEVEL TWO
Walk up our first set of PINK steps to the second floor. Here there is the Master bedroom (Dolly Parton Themed) with two queen beds, Smart TV, Spacious closet, connected bathroom with Shower, and outdoor patio with seating. On this level you will also find the Laundry room available to guests. Just past this you will find the next full bathroom with bathtub/shower. Down the hallway is another bedroom with a double over queen bunk, a spacious closet and second closet/lounge area and Smart TV. Before leaving this floor make sure to grab a photo in front of our very own "LIPS" painted mural and giant PINK hand chair!

LEVEL THREE
Up the final set of colorful stairs you will be greeted by our very own Retro 1980's CLAW MACHINE named Jolene! Bring your quarters as Jolene is always stocked full of fun Nashville items for your group! On this level you will find a spacious living room with a Queen pull out couch, smart tv, Gum-ball machine and yet another Wall mural for your photo ops! Play some tunes on our record player with all the country/rock classics! Also on this level is the fully stocked kitchen with drip coffee maker, keurig and all you will need to cook a full meal. Next to the kitchen is the 3rd half bathroom (Rock and Roll Themed). Don't forget about the best part... the private ROOFTOP VIEW of the downtown Nashville skyline! You will not find a better view of the City! The rooftop has an outdoor sectional with propane fire pit, Table with seating for 8, and even a giant connect 4 game. Snag your last and best photo up here, the sunsets are spectacular!

1st Floor:Bedroom (1 King)
2nd Floor: Bedroom (2 queens), Bedroom (1 queen with loft double) 2 full bathrooms
3rd Floor: Living room, Kitchen, Rooftop Balcony with City View, sofa bed, smart TV, Claw machine

-All bedrooms equipped with smart TV's, plenty of pillows and extra linens and blankets
-Bathrooms equipped with towels, shampoo & conditioner, body soap, blow dryers.

***Pantry in living room is stocked full of party decor. Use whatever you like during your stay!***

Other things to note
PARKING- open parking on street as well as complex parking lot. First come but is usually open. Also we have 1 parking spot in the garage. Please keep garage closed to prevent bugs/critters from getting in. Thank you!!
